context: Two colleagues debrief after a campaign
purpose: Debrief a campaign; teach 市内/赤字/外部/再度/づくり/お尋ね/自覚

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 市内キャンペーン、効果はどうでした？
lines.en: How did the in-city campaign perform?
lines.style: curious assistant seeking the results, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 集客は伸びたけど、赤字は埋まりきらない。
lines.en: Foot traffic rose, but it didn’t fill the deficit.
lines.style: realistic manager tempering the good news

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 外部の広告会社、費用が高くて。
lines.en: The outside ad agency was expensive.
lines.style: frank assistant flagging the cost, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 再度、予算を組み直す必要があるね。
lines.en: We need to rebuild the budget again.
lines.style: practical manager planning the next step

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 仕組みづくりが甘かったと反省しています。
lines.en: I regret that the system-building was weak.
lines.style: self-critical assistant taking responsibility, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 顧客との関係づくりも長期で考えよう。
lines.en: Let us think of customer relationship-building long-term.
lines.style: thoughtful manager widening the horizon, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 部長にお尋ねしてから進めます。
lines.en: I will ask the director before proceeding.
lines.style: careful assistant respecting the chain, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: お互い、責任の自覚を持って取り組もう。
lines.en: Let us both work with a sense of responsibility.
lines.style: collegial manager fostering shared resolve, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced
